$comment: Spoke brokers removed from hub in Mode 2: no direct spoke ActiveMQArtemis CRs rendered when spokeProvisioning.enabled=true. Mode 1 still renders them.

criteria.$comment: Mode 2 helm template renders exactly one direct ActiveMQArtemis (hub-01-broker), not spoke-01 or spoke-02
criteria.target: helm template test . -f values.yaml -f values-mode2.yaml 2>&1 | awk '/^kind: ActiveMQArtemis/{found=1} found && /^  name:/{print; found=0}' | grep -q hub-01-broker && ! helm template test . -f values.yaml -f values-mode2.yaml 2>&1 | awk '/^kind: ActiveMQArtemis/{found=1} found && /^  name:/{print; found=0}' | grep -q spoke

criteria.$comment: Mode 1 still renders spoke broker CRs
criteria.target: helm template test . -f values.yaml 2>&1 | awk '/^kind: ActiveMQArtemis/{found=1} found && /^  name:/{print; found=0}' | grep -q spoke-01-broker

criteria.$comment: ACM policies for spoke brokers still rendered in Mode 2
criteria.target: helm template test . -f values.yaml -f values-mode2.yaml 2>&1 | grep -q policy-amq-broker-spoke-01
